place.name: Sumida River ferry below Matsuchiyama, Asakusa, Tokyo

crop_note: triptych; mount margin excluded on all sides, sheet joins kept
evidence: Ferry passengers under snow-laden umbrellas, boatman in a straw rain cape; snow heavy on the trees of Matsuchiyama and the roofs along the far bank, under a flat grey sky. Title gives dusk (tasogare) and the second month (Kisaragi), but the light is still grey daylight, so a day share.
taxonomy_friction: Second lunar month with deep snow: mostly winter, a little spring.
